name: rococo-vintage-luxury-dream
image_purpose: Rococo lookbook and vintage luxury editorial

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic Rococo-inspired fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman seated on an ornate sofa in a pastel luxury interior.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with a soft sleek bun tied with a light-blue ribbon, natural dewy skin, neutral high-fashion expression, floral tapestry corset with lace trim and ribbon lacing, pale-yellow pleated mini-skirt, sheer white opera gloves, white lace-knit knee-high socks with small bows, and delicate silver drop earrings.
composition_elements: Eye-level full-body portrait, seated gracefully on the back of a sofa with knees tucked naturally.
One hand gently touches the chin; the other rests behind on lace fabric.
White ornate fireplace mantel, paneled door, gold-framed mirror reflecting a red fringed lamp, floral sofa with white lace throw.
Ornate silver hand mirror on the seat and white floral bouquet in a silver pedestal vase.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused indoor lighting, gentle shadows, bright airy atmosphere, pastel cream, pale yellow, sage, gold, and deep-red reflection accents.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm prime lens, f/2.8, ultra-photorealistic RAW photography, 8K detail, realistic tapestry, lace, velvet, wood, metal, and skin texture, no text or watermark.
